teaser: Season of Discovery's library books are back in Forever, with jewellery instead of runes: hand ten different books to a librarian for a necklace, twenty for a ring. All 40 books in Forever's database, with positions and containers where known, what is still unconfirmed in the beta, and a tracker that stays in your browser.
intro: Library books are a collectable questline that World of Warcraft: Forever brings back from Season of Discovery. Around Azeroth, books, scrolls and tomes sit on tables, shelves and altars; each one is a quest item that a librarian in Stormwind or Undercity takes off your hands. In Forever the milestone rewards are new: a necklace after ten different books and a ring after twenty.
sod: The questline arrived with Season of Discovery's first phase (patch 1.15.0, November 2023) with sixteen books; eight more came with each of phases 2, 3 and 4 (patches 1.15.1 to 1.15.3, February to July 2024), for 40 books in all. There it was a mage affair: every quest was mage-only, each book paid a Comprehension Charm, the item mages used to decipher scrambled scrolls and Spell Notes (which is how several mage runes were unlocked), and the milestone quests handed out runes: Icy Veins after 10 books, Spell Power after 20, Deep Freeze after 25 and Arcane Barrage after 35. Forever's database holds all 40 book quests. It keeps the books, the librarians and the quests, but the milestones now pay jewellery any class can wear, and mages get a new quest of their own.
how: Books do not drop from mobs. Each one is looted from a fixed object in the world: a Spellbook, Scrolls, a Manual, a Tome, or in one case a mural you trace.

Bring a book to your faction's librarian: Garion Wendell in Stormwind's Mage Quarter or Owen Thadd in Undercity's Magic Quarter. Beta players report the librarian only offers the quest while a book is in your bags.

Every book is its own quest, so hand them in one at a time as you find them. Each turn-in pays a Comprehension Charm, an item mages use to read scrambled scrolls; Wowhead's Forever database also lists the charm at reagent vendors in the capitals, so nobody needs to hoard books for it.

Any class can take part: a level 1 warrior picked up the first quest in the beta. The quests still carry their Season of Discovery levels (20, 35, 45 and 60 by set) but none of them has a level requirement; the danger is the zones.

After ten different books the librarian offers Friend of the Library: pick one of two necklaces. After twenty in total, Greater Friend of the Library: pick one of two rings. The first ten count towards the twenty.
Books are unique and bind when picked up. A book that stands in two places still counts once.
Mages also get Research Access, a quest new in Forever that teaches the Comprehension skill and its spell Study.

rewards.label: 10 different books: choose a necklace
rewards.text: Offered once you have handed in ten different books. Both necklaces are Rare with no class restriction; Wowhead's tooltips show no level requirement and beta players report none. In Season of Discovery this quest paid the Icy Veins rune instead, and Wowhead's Forever entry still lists that rune next to the jewellery; beta players report only the jewellery being offered.

rewards.label: 20 books in total: choose a ring
rewards.text: Offered at twenty different books; the ten from the necklace count. Both rings are Rare; Wowhead's tooltips show no level requirement and beta players report none. The first two sets hold 24 books, so you do not need the later sets for the ring. In Season of Discovery this quest paid the Spell Power boots rune, which Wowhead's Forever entry still lists next to the rings.

items.name: Philanthropist's Ring
stats: Equip: Increases damage and healing done by magical spells and effects by up to 10.

text: The librarians also give mages a quest of their own, Research Access, which is new in Forever. It teaches a new skill (ForeverChanges calls it Comprehension, Warcraft Tavern calls it Research) and the spell Study. Nobody knows yet how many books you must hand in before the quest appears.

Study needs level 6 and a Light Feather, takes 6 seconds to cast, has a one-hour cooldown and reads: “Perform spell research, resulting in a bundle of scrolls. Requires a suitable library.” The Bundle of Scrolls it makes is opened for scrolls.

Beta bug: mages report the new skill and its window disappearing after a relog (a Blizzard forum thread from 20 September 2026 and comments under Warcraft Tavern's article). The thread had no Blizzard reply as of 24 September.

sets.label: First set
sets.desc: The sixteen books from Season of Discovery's first phase. They sit in the level 5-30 zones and the capital cities, so most characters can collect the ten needed for the necklace while levelling. Quest level 20.

sets.label: Second set (level 35 quests)
sets.desc: Eight books in level 25-45 zones, added in Season of Discovery's second phase. The quests are labelled level 35 but have no level requirement; the danger is the zones, not the quest.

sets.label: Third set (level 45 quests)
sets.desc: Eight books in level 40-55 zones from Season of Discovery's third phase. Wowhead has no container for two of them, and one sat in event content Forever does not have, so seven are realistically available.

sets.label: Fourth set (level 60 quests)
sets.desc: Eight books in the level 50-60 zones from Season of Discovery's fourth phase. All eight quests are in Forever's database and pay a Comprehension Charm like the others, and a beta player has already found one. In Season of Discovery these went to the mage trainers Jennea Cannon (Stormwind) and Oran Snakewrithe (Undercity) rather than the librarians; who takes them in Forever has not been reported.

books.name: Archmage Theocritus' Research Journal
books.flavor: Research notes from the Tower of Azora. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On a table halfway up the tower.

books.name: Archmage Antonidas: The Unabridged Autobiography
books.flavor: Somewhat self-indulgent, but nevertheless a fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On a table in the middle of the hall.

books.name: Bewitchments and Glamours
books.flavor: Spells for manipulation and deception. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: Inside a house in Moonbrook.

books.name: Rumi of Gnomeregan: The Collected Works
books.flavor: The writings of a notable Gnome mage. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: In the Thelsamar inn, or at Sentinel Hill. Once you have taken it in one place you cannot take it again in the other.

books.name: Crimes Against Anatomy
books.flavor: Written by Doctor Krastinov. A questionable addition to any library's collection.
books.note: Wowhead shows two pins a step apart.

books.name: Runes of the Sorcerer-Kings
books.flavor: A relic of the mighty ogre empires of Draenor. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: Among the ogres in the north-east of the loch.

books.name: Goaz Scrolls
books.flavor: Written in lost Titan script, but nevertheless a fine addition to any library's collection.

books.name: The Dalaran Digest, Vol. 23
books.flavor: Arcane research of the Kirin Tor. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: In the town hall.

books.name: The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer
books.flavor: Elementary notes on arcane theory and spell research, compiled by Archmage Rotwick of the Royal Apothecary Society. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On a shelf beside Apothecary Johaan in the alchemy shop.

books.name: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities
books.flavor: The writings of a notable Kirin Tor archmage. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.note: Wowhead puts the container in the tomb beside Sebastian Meloche, where it stood in Season of Discovery, but beta players report finding nothing there. The book behind Arugal in Shadowfang Keep is the Black Tome, a different quest item.

books.name: Nar'thalas Almanac, Vol. 74
books.flavor: Arcane research of the ancient quel'dorei. A fine addition to any library's collection.

books.name: Arcanic Systems Manual
books.flavor: Poorly-organized troubleshooting tips for goblin technology. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: In the oil rig's control room.

books.name: Baxtan: On Destructive Magics
books.flavor: The writings of a notable Goblin mage. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: Next to Gazlowe.

books.name: Secrets of the Dreamers
books.flavor: Observations and insights on the Emerald Dream. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.subzone: Cavern of Mists (the Wailing Caverns cave)
books.directions: Enter the cave at Lushwater Oasis (46.0, 36.5) and follow it towards the Wailing Caverns instance entrance. Wowhead has no position for this book; in Season of Discovery it lay on the ground by the instance portal.
books.note: Position and container reported by two beta players on 22 September 2026.

books.name: Fury of the Land
books.flavor: Closely guarded shamanistic secrets of the Grimtotem clan. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: The Grimtotem camp in the south-east of the zone.

books.name: The Lessons of Ta'zo
books.flavor: A tracing of etchings written by a great Troll mage. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: A large tablet in front of the Darkbriar Lodge. Click the mural to trace it; the tracing is the book.
books.note: Position confirmed by a beta player on 22 September 2026. Wowhead shows five pins for the mural, four around this spot and one at 33.9, 84.4.

books.name: Basilisks: Should Petrification be Feared?
books.flavor: Attempted research on the use of basilisk parts as reagents. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: Outside the mine, on a platform by its mouth; you never have to go in.
books.note: Wowhead shows two pins a step apart.

books.name: Defensive Magics 101
books.flavor: An introductory guide to defensive magic and barriers. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: Inside a tower of the ogre-held ruins.

books.name: A Web of Lies: Debunking Myths and Legends
books.flavor: An incomplete thesis claiming spiders are harmless, but nevertheless a fine addition to any library's collection.

books.name: Mummies: A Guide to the Unsavory Undead
books.flavor: Tales frightening enough to scare even the most hardy of warriors. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: Inside the crypt on the south side of the butte; the path to it starts near 56.0, 45.0.

books.name: A Luddite's Guide to Caring for Your Demonic Pet
books.flavor: Contains useful tips for keeping pet imps out of your reagents. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.note: In Season of Discovery the book sat in a locked cage and the Lost Ones nearby dropped the Rusted Cage Key for it; whether Forever keeps the lock has not been checked. Wowhead shows four pins within a few yards.

books.name: Geomancy: The Stone-Cold Truth
books.flavor: Theories on the origin and usage of elemental magic. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: In a hut on the pinnacle; the path up starts at about 31.0, 37.0.

books.name: Demons and You
books.flavor: A strange text defending demons, yet nevertheless a fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On a bench inside the large building.

books.name: RwlRwlRwlRwl!
books.flavor: The strange passages are faint but somewhat readable despite water damage. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On the ground at the eastern edge of the murloc camp.

books.name: Sanguine Sorcery
books.flavor: Outlines a variety of powerful blood rituals. A controversial addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On top of the temple, outside the instance.
books.note: Wowhead lists no container for this book. The position is where it stood in Season of Discovery, and a beta reader placed it there again; not checked by us.

books.name: Stonewrought Design
books.flavor: Sturdy architectural techniques capable of withstanding all but the most cataclysmic disasters. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On the altar of the tomb in the middle of the mountain, where a dwarf's ghost stands. No dungeon needed.
books.note: Wowhead lists no container for this book. The tomb is where it stood in Season of Discovery, and a beta reader placed it there again; not checked by us.

books.name: Venomous Journeys
books.flavor: Notes on the mind-altering properties of various toxins and venoms. A fine addition to any library's collection.

books.name: A Mind of Metal
books.flavor: Dwarven techniques for applying magic to metallurgy, strip-mining and heavy industry. An informative, if bleak, addition to any library's collection.

books.name: Conjurer's Codex
books.flavor: A pre-war collection of spells and arcane theories that have largely fallen out of modern use. A fine addition to any library's collection.

books.name: Legends of the Tidesages
books.flavor: Covered in illegible notes and diagrams scrawled by an unsteady hand. It could still be a decent addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On a bookshelf inside one of the pirate buildings.

books.name: Everyday Etiquette
books.flavor: A guide to the role of elementary magic in polite Highborne society. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On a crate next to a hut.

books.name: The Liminal and the Arcane
books.flavor: The words swim on the page, defying attempts to read them. A puzzling addition to any library's collection.
books.note: In Season of Discovery this book could only be reached through the Dream Bough portal during a Nightmare Incursion, an event Forever does not have. Wowhead still lists the position, but nobody has reached it in the beta, so treat it as unavailable.

books.name: Undead Potatoes
books.flavor: Notes on the impact of the scourge on farming. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: Inside the farmhouse.

books.name: Necromancy 101
books.flavor: A beginner's guide to one's first foray into raising the dead. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On a table in the ruined keep above Scholomance.
books.note: Wowhead does not link this book to a container; the Book object at this position matches where it lay in Season of Discovery.

books.name: A Study of the Light
books.flavor: Teachings of the Light with notes from the perspective of a famous mage. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.note: Wowhead shows a second pin for the same object at 71.8, 48.3.

books.name: The Knight and the Lady
books.flavor: A well-worn fictional novel with handwritten notes in the margins. An interesting addition to any library's collection.

books.name: Scourge: Undead Menace or Misunderstood?
books.flavor: A controversial collection of notes questioning the dangers of the Scourge. A fine addition to any library's collection.

books.name: Magma or Lava?
books.flavor: Well-versed notes on the difference between different fire elementals. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.note: Wowhead lists no container and no position for this book in Forever. In Season of Discovery it sat near the Blackrock Depths entrance.

books.name: Northern Kalimdor - A Comprehensive Guide
books.flavor: The definitive guidebook for touring the northern reaches of Kalimdor. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: Inside the Timbermaw tunnel between Felwood and Winterspring.
books.note: Found there by a beta player on 24 September 2026.

books.name: Ka-Boom!
books.flavor: Scrawlings from an enterprising engineer on integrating explosives into technology. A fine addition to any library's collection.
books.directions: On a shelf behind the alchemy supplier.

open: Ataeric: On Arcane Curiosities has not been found. Wowhead puts it in the Sepulcher's tomb; beta players report an empty spot.
The Liminal and the Arcane sat inside a Season of Discovery event that Forever does not have; it is listed as unavailable until someone reaches it.
Greater Friend of the Library also exists at 25 and 35 books in the Forever database, but those versions list no reward beyond the old mage runes. Nobody has reported being offered them.
How many books a mage must hand in before Research Access appears.
Whether the Comprehension Charm, still labelled a mage item, does anything for other classes.

In Season of Discovery three of the first-set books were Horde-only (The Lessons of Ta'zo, The Apothecary's Metaphysical Primer, Ataeric) and two Alliance-only (the two Archmage books): the other faction's librarian did not take them. Whether Forever keeps that split has not been checked.
Who takes the eight level-60 books in Forever: in Season of Discovery it was the mage trainers Jennea Cannon and Oran Snakewrithe, not the librarians. Both NPCs exist in Forever.
Magma or Lava? has no position in Wowhead's Forever database; in Season of Discovery it sat near the Blackrock Depths entrance.
